extract_msa_features_protein: extract MSA features from protein sequences returning MSA and deletion count numpy arrays
extract_msa_features_rna: extract MSA features from RNA sequences returning MSA and deletion count numpy arrays
extract_msa_features_dna: extract MSA features from DNA sequences returning MSA and deletion count numpy arrays
extract_species_ids_uniprot: extract species IDs from UniProtKB MSA description strings using regex pattern matching
review_msa_feature_mappings: review the protein RNA and DNA residue to integer ID mapping dictionaries
